approach: The paper's exact system is the authors' own fastText C++ supervised trainer, and the repo ships classification-results.sh which downloads the Zhang et al. 8-dataset release and trains/evaluates every Table 1 row, so the plan is plumbing rather than re-implementation: get a working fasttext engine, get AG News in `__label__N` format, then run the authors' configuration `-dim 10 -wordNgrams 2 -epoch 5 -lr <lr> -thread 20`. A thin reproduce.py drives everything with the Python binding (fasttext-wheel on Windows, native build or `make` when a POSIX toolchain exists), reconstructs the missing validation split (10% of the 120k train set, assumption A4) to pick lr from {0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5}, then retrains on the full training set and evaluates on the official 7.6k test set.
